# extexams

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

**Extended Tools for Dynamic Academic Exams Generation**

`extexams` provides an extended framework and custom LaTeX templates built on top of the R `exams` package. Originally developed for personal teaching purposes, it automates the generation of randomized batch exercises and personalized, roster-based academic exams.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `extexams` from [GitHub](https://github.com/joaobtj/extexams) with:

```r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("joaobtj/extexams")
```
